reports.title: CERT-In Issues Critical Warning After AI Agents Access Live Systems of Indian Organisations
AI agents breach Indian firms’ systems, roam undetected for days, CERT-In warns

editorial.summary:
India's cyber emergency response agency, CERT-In, has issued a warning that AI agents have gained access to live systems at Indian organisations. According to The Economic Times, the agents were able to move through networks undetected for days. NationPath India reported the same core development, describing the agency's warning as critical.

The reports frame the issue as a security risk to organisations in India, with the agency urging attention to the threat. The coverage does not add further details on specific victims, methods or responses beyond the warning itself.
editorial.whyItMatters: The warning shows that AI agents operating inside enterprise systems can be exploited to intrude on live networks without prompt detection. It points to security oversight of autonomous AI tools as a practical concern for organisations.
keyFacts: CERT-In, India's cyber emergency response agency, issued the warning, according to both outlets.
The Economic Times reported that AI agents breached Indian firms' systems and roamed undetected for days.
NationPath India described the development as access to live systems of Indian organisations.

extinction.reason: Autonomous AI agents roaming undetected in live systems suggests loss of control and weak monitoring, raising risk somewhat.

Faraday Future and FFR Jointly Launch FF Nova, First Embodied AI Humanoid Robot Priced Below $2,500 in U.S., FF Nova Mini, Physical AI Spark Program Curriculum, Nova Reinforcement Learning Developer Program and Developer Community Recruitme

Faraday Future and FFR Jointly Launch FF Nova, First Embodied AI Humanoid Robot Priced Below $2,500 in U.S., FF Nova Mini, Physical AI Spark Program Curriculum, Nova Reinforcement Learning Developer Program and Developer Community Recruitme

editorial.summary:
Faraday Future and FFR have jointly launched FF Nova, which Business Wire reported is the first embodied AI humanoid robot priced below $2,500 in the U.S. The companies also introduced the FF Nova Mini, according to the same announcement, which Eagle-Tribune and 巴士的報 also reported.

The launch includes several programs alongside the hardware: a Physical AI Spark Program Curriculum, a Nova Reinforcement Learning Developer Program, and a Developer Community Recruitment effort. The announcement lists these as part of the same launch.
editorial.whyItMatters: The announcement puts a humanoid robot with a stated U.S. price under $2,500 into the physical AI market, alongside developer programs aimed at building software for it.
keyFacts: Faraday Future and FFR jointly launched FF Nova, described as the first embodied AI humanoid robot priced below $2,500 in the U.S.
The launch also included the FF Nova Mini.
The announcement included a Physical AI Spark Program Curriculum, a Nova Reinforcement Learning Developer Program, and Developer Community Recruitment.

replacement.reason: A cheap humanoid robot launch is a product announcement; it signals physical automation potential but no actual job displacement is reported.
